title: arctium palladinii
intro: Arctium palladinii, commonly known as the Great Thistle or Woolly Thistle, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used to support digestive health and has been employed in folk medicine to treat various gastrointestinal issues, including diarrhea and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Arctium palladinii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal effects.
